_comment: Golden design constants. See golden/README.md for the naming convention and CLAUDE.md 'Golden designs' for how this fits the project. Do not hand-edit numbers here without re-running the CLI and re-deriving them.

launch.description: Real Taoglas EMPCB.SMAFSTJ.B.HT SMA + impedance-matched CPWG launch (gap 0.2512mm, ground inner edge 0.8512mm, feed 1.2mm, 6 stitch vias/side, solved 50.00 ohm) -- topologies/cascade.py's TAOGLAS_SMA, the actual default for every cascade mesh since 2026-08-31.

known_open_item: NOT landed -- S11w -6.1dB (exact) / -8.5dB (fab-rounded) vs the -16dB spec, bw ~200-216MHz vs the 143.5MHz target. This is a genuine local optimum: two independent local GP search rounds (span=2mm each, patience=16) both converged to this exact point, one seeded fresh from the calibrate-and-invert pipeline's fc-trimmed design, the other re-centered on the first round's result. Materially rougher than the N=3 golden entry at the same stage, despite N=4 having more coupling DOF (2 independent iris widths) -- more DOF made the search harder within the evaluated budget, not easier. Kept as the best-known N=4 point, not a landed design.

provenance.reproduce_with: siw synth-design --N 4 --no-mid-trim --np 8, then siw design --topology cascade --N 4 --seed <fc-trimmed params> --span 2 --patience 16 --evals 45 --np 8 (twice, second seeded on the first's result)
